verdict.rationale: Gram exposes a CLI (gram-docs-4,21,30) and a first-party 'platform MCP' server (gram-docs-7,22) that explicitly let an org admin find/add servers, finish setup, author skills, manage risk policies, and read observability data 'without opening the dashboard,' showing real UI/CLI parity for governance workflows. However, a direct probe found no public REST/OpenAPI API at standard paths (gram-probe-3), and dashboard-only elements like spend/session analytics widgets (gram-docs-25,26) aren't shown to be fully replicable via CLI/MCP. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose REST API (not just CLI/MCP), and confirmation that all dashboard analytics/reporting views have programmatic equivalents.
